lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.unitTitle: Data: Scaled Graphs and Measurement Line Plots
lessonRef.focus: the graph, line plot, and interpretation
lessonRef.title: Performance task: build: the graph, line plot, and interpretation

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Set up the first two carefully; the rest of the build depends on them.

items.prompt: A line plot shows the lengths of 8 leaves, each measured to the nearest 1/4 inch: 3/4, 1/4, 4/4, 4/4, 3/4, 2/4, 2/4, 4/4. How many leaves measured exactly 3/4 inch?
A scaled bar graph shows a survey where each bar length equals a count of 2 per symbol. The bar for "Fish" is worth 1 symbols. How many does "Fish" represent?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: On a scaled bar graph with 5 per symbol, "Dogs" has 5 symbols and "Cats" has 1 symbols. How many more does "Dogs" have than "Cats"?
A line plot shows the lengths of 8 leaves, each measured to the nearest 1/4 inch: 1/4, 4/4, 2/4, 1/4, 3/4, 1/4, 4/4, 1/4. How many leaves measured exactly 1/4 inch?
A scaled bar graph shows a survey where each bar length equals a count of 5 per symbol. The bar for "Fish" is worth 7 symbols. How many does "Fish" represent?
On a scaled bar graph with 10 per symbol, "Apples" has 8 symbols and "Bananas" has 4 symbols. How many more does "Apples" have than "Bananas"?
A line plot shows the lengths of 8 leaves, each measured to the nearest 1/8 inch: 1/8, 1/8, 7/8, 6/8, 7/8, 3/8, 3/8, 2/8. How many leaves measured exactly 1/8 inch?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Carry the build to a result and say how you would check it is right.

items.prompt: A scaled bar graph shows a survey where each bar length equals a count of 10 per symbol. The bar for "Grapes" is worth 3 symbols. How many does "Grapes" represent?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: On a scaled bar graph with 5 per symbol, "Apples" has 4 symbols and "Bananas" has 2 symbols. How many more does "Apples" have than "Bananas"?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
